title: Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) Service Description: Plan Features Compared
content:
Plan features of Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) are Microsoft's own and decide which plan fits a requirement. This comparison sets out, for every plan, the mailbox, storage, application, device-management, identity, endpoint-protection and Windows features it includes.

## Mail, storage and applications

| Plan | Exchange Online mailbox per user | Exchange Online Archiving | Mailbox litigation hold | OneDrive storage per user | Microsoft 365 Apps for desktop | Desktop installs per user (PCs or Macs) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | 50 GB | no | no | 1024 GB | no | 0 |
| Microsoft 365 F3 | 2 GB | no | no | 2 GB | no | 0 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | 50 GB | no | no | 1024 GB | yes | 5 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | 50 GB | yes | yes | 1024 GB | yes | 5 |
| Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) | 100 GB | yes | yes | 1024 GB | yes | 5 |
| Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | 100 GB | yes | yes | 1024 GB | yes | 5 |

## Devices, identity, protection and collaboration

| Plan | Microsoft Intune device management | Microsoft Entra ID plan | Endpoint protection plan | Windows licensing | Microsoft Teams included | Base licence for the Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | no | Free | none | none | yes | yes |
| Microsoft 365 F3 | yes | P1 | none | none | yes | yes |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | no | Free | none | none | yes | yes |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | yes | P1 | Microsoft Defender for Business | Windows Business upgrade | yes | yes |
| Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) | yes | P1 | Microsoft Defender for Endpoint P1 | Windows Enterprise E3 | no | yes |
| Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | yes | P2 | Microsoft Defender for Endpoint P2 | Windows Enterprise E5 | no | yes |

Microsoft Teams included means whether Teams is part of the plan. The plans without Teams need a separate Teams licence.

## Matching a requirement to a plan

- Archiving and litigation hold come together, on Microsoft 365 Business Premium and both E plans.
- Installable desktop apps are included on every plan from Microsoft 365 Business Standard upward, each user installing on up to 5 PCs or Macs. Microsoft 365 Business Basic and Microsoft 365 F3 have none.
- Entra ID P2 and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint P2 are included only on Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams).
- Every plan qualifies as a base licence for the Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on.
- Microsoft 365 F3 has a 2 GB mailbox and 2 GB of OneDrive storage, and it carries Intune and Entra ID P1.
